mkdir -p /Users/willgerstung/projects/woodshed/Source && cd /Users/willgerstung/projects/woodshed && git init -q && printf 'build/
.DS_Store
*.wav
' > .gitignore && echo ok
touch Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp Source/StandaloneApp.cpp && cmake -B build -G Xcode 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /Users/willgerstung/projects/woodshed && cmake -B build -G Xcode >/dev/null && cmake --build build --config Release --target Woodshed_Standalone -- -quiet 2>&1 | grep -E "error|warning: .*Source/|BUILD" | head -40; ls build/Woodshed_artefacts/Release/Standalone 2>&1

sed -i '' 's|#include <juce_audio_plugin_client/juce_audio_plugin_client.h>|#include <juce_audio_utils/juce_audio_utils.h>|' Source/StandaloneApp.cpp && sed -i '' 's|^ #include <juce_audio_plugin_client/Standalone/juce_StandaloneFilterWindow.h>| #include <juce_audio_utils/juce_audio_utils.h>\n #include <juce_audio_plugin_client/Standalone/juce_StandaloneFilterWindow.h>|' Source/PluginEditor.cpp && cmake --build build --config Release --target Woodshed_Standalone -- -quiet 2>&1 | grep -E "error|warning: .*Source/|BUILD" | head -30

sed -i '' 's|#include "PluginEditor.h"|#include "PluginEditor.h"\n#include <juce_audio_formats/juce_audio_formats.h>|' Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && head -3 Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && cmake --build build --config Release --target Woodshed_Standalone -- -quiet 2>&1 | grep -E "error|warning|BUILD" | head -30

sed -i '' 's/WoodshedProcessor& processor;/WoodshedProcessor\& woodshedProcessor;/' Source/PluginEditor.h && sed -i '' 's/AudioProcessorEditor (p), processor (p)/AudioProcessorEditor (p), woodshedProcessor (p)/; s/processor\./woodshedProcessor./g' Source/PluginEditor.cpp && sed -i '' '/JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0/d' CMakeLists.txt && sed -n 171p Source/PluginEditor.cpp && sed -n 255p Source/PluginEditor.cpp && grep -n "woodshedProcessor\|processor" Source/PluginEditor.cpp | head -20

sed -i '' 's/g.fillRect (r.getX() + gap + i \* (segW + gap)/g.fillRect (r.getX() + gap + (float) i * (segW + gap)/; s/const float segW = (r.getWidth() - gap \* (segments + 1)) \/ segments;/const float segW = (r.getWidth() - gap * (float) (segments + 1)) \/ (float) segments;/; s/const float t = (float) i \/ (segments - 1);/const float t = (float) i \/ (float) (segments - 1);/; s/std::abs (t - hold) < 0.5f \/ segments/std::abs (t - hold) < 0.5f \/ (float) segments/; s/auto knobArea = r.removeFromTop ((int) (getHeight() \* 0.44f));/auto knobArea = r.removeFromTop ((int) ((float) getHeight() * 0.44f));/' Source/PluginEditor.cpp && cmake -B build -G Xcode >/dev/null && cmake --build build --config Release --target Woodshed_Standalone -- -quiet 2>&1 | grep -E "Source/.*(error|warning)|BUILD FAILED" | head

open build/Woodshed_artefacts/Release/Standalone/Woodshed.app && sleep 4 && pgrep -l Woodshed; screencapture -x -l$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get id of first window of (first process whose name is "Woodshed")' 2>/dev/null) /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-willgerstung-projects/4d868672-2c26-4d9a-9fe1-1021ae2d4242/scratchpad/ws1.png 2>&1 || screencapture -x /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-willgerstung-projects/4d868672-2c26-4d9a-9fe1-1021ae2d4242/scratchpad/ws1.png; cat ~/Library/Application\ Support/Woodshed.settings 2>/dev/null | head -20
